# Large Codebase Performance Optimization

Optimize indexing, search, and analysis for codebases with 100,000+ files. Implement incremental updates, smart caching, and parallel processing. Reduce memory footprint for large projects.

## Rationale
Technical debt item: Large codebase with 24,000+ source files. Critical for enterprise adoption and projects that grow over time. Addresses user pain point about context switching in large projects.

## User Stories
- As an enterprise developer, I want to use Turret on our large monorepo without performance issues
- As a developer, I want quick project switching so that I can work across multiple repositories

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Indexing 100,000 files completes in under 5 minutes
- [ ] Incremental updates process only changed files
- [ ] Memory usage stays under 2GB for typical operations
- [ ] Search returns results in under 2 seconds for any query
- [ ] Performance benchmarks are automated in CI
